details: For every finite concept class, $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{BTD}(\mathcal H)$. The singleton-plus-empty-set family gives an unbounded gap: $\mathrm{TD}=n$ while $\mathrm{BTD}=2$.
name: Teaching Dimension / Balbach Teaching Dimension
proof_source: The nonincrease argument in Proposition \ref{prop:balbach-monotonicity} shows that every iterated target value is at most its ordinary teaching size. Each step reuses the preceding stage's optimal sample, which still retains its target; it does not assume an original ordinary teaching sample remains admissible forever.
